def get_Inv_Count(arr):
    values = list(arr)
    temp = [0] * len(values)

    def merge_count(start, end):
        if end - start <= 1:
            return 0

        mid = (start + end) // 2
        count = merge_count(start, mid) + merge_count(mid, end)
        i, j, k = start, mid, start

        while i < mid and j < end:
            if values[i] <= values[j]:
                temp[k] = values[i]
                i += 1
            else:
                temp[k] = values[j]
                j += 1
                count += mid - i
            k += 1

        while i < mid:
            temp[k] = values[i]
            i += 1
            k += 1

        while j < end:
            temp[k] = values[j]
            j += 1
            k += 1

        values[start:end] = temp[start:end]
        return count

    return merge_count(0, len(values))
